title: Minimum Cost to Reach City With Discounts
goal: Reach the last city at minimum toll while spending at most the available discounts.
strategy: A city alone is not a complete state: arriving with discounts left can be more useful than arriving slightly cheaper without them. Run Dijkstra on city and discounts-used pairs.
